mapper.insert:
/* 엔진에서 조회한 워크플로우 목록 호출 - upsertOcrWfM */ MERGE INTO ocuoc_ocrwf_m tgt USING ( SELECT #{wkId} AS WK_ID, #{wkNm} AS WK_NM, #{wkDesc} AS WK_DESC, #{docTypNm} AS DOC_TYP_NM, #{wkStatCd} AS WK_STAT_CD, #{activeReleaseId} AS ACTIVE_RELEASE_ID, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{activatedAt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ACTIVATED_AT, SYSTIMESTAMP AS SYNC_DT, #{rgsrId} AS RGSR_ID, SYSTIMESTAMP AS REG_DT FROM dual ) src
ON (tgt.WK_ID = src.WK_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET tgt.WK_NM = src.WK_NM, tgt.DOC_TYP_NM = src.DOC_TYP_NM, tgt.WK_DESC = src.WK_DESC, tgt.WK_STAT_CD = src.WK_STAT_CD, tgt.ACTIVE_RELEASE_ID = src.ACTIVE_RELEASE_ID, tgt.ACTIVATED_AT = src.ACTIVATED_AT, tgt.SYNC_DT = src.SYNC_DT, tgt.EDTR_ID = src.RGSR_ID, tgt.CHNG_DT = src.REG_DT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( WK_ID, WK_NM, WK_DESC, DOC_TYP_NM, WK_STAT_CD, ACTIVE_RELEASE_ID, ACTIVATED_AT, SYNC_DT, RGSR_ID, REG_DT ) VALUES ( src.WK_ID, src.WK_NM, src.WK_DESC, src.DOC_TYP_NM, src.WK_STAT_CD, src.ACTIVE_RELEASE_ID, src.ACTIVATED_AT, src.SYNC_DT, src.RGSR_ID, src.REG_DT )
mapper.select: /* 연결 계산용 서식 전체 - selectFormsForLink */ SELECT F.LEFRM_ID AS lefrmId, F.DOC_ID AS docId FROM ocuoc_lefrm_m F ORDER BY F.LEFRM_ID
/* 현재 업무-서식 연결 전체 - selectAllOcrWll */ SELECT WL.WK_ID AS wkId, WL.LEFRM_ID AS lefrmId FROM ocuoc_ocrwl_l WL

/* 저장된 분류 클래스 사본과 그때의 릴리스 - selectStoredClasses */ SELECT WC.WK_ID AS wkId, W.ACTIVE_RELEASE_ID AS activeReleaseId, WC.CLASS_NM AS className, WC.DOC_TYP_CD AS docTypeCode FROM ocuoc_ocrwc_l WC JOIN ocuoc_ocrwf_m W ON W.WK_ID = WC.WK_ID ORDER BY WC.WK_ID, WC.CLASS_SEQ
mapper.delete: /* 워크플로우의 서식 매핑 전체 삭제(동기화 시 다시 만든다) - deleteOcrWllByWkId */ DELETE FROM ocuoc_ocrwl_l WHERE WK_ID = #{wkId}
mapper.insert: /* 매칭된 워크플로우-서식 매핑 등록 - insertOcrWll */ MERGE INTO ocuoc_ocrwl_l tgt USING ( SELECT #{wkId} AS WK_ID, #{lefrmId} AS LEFRM_ID, #{rgsrId} AS RGSR_ID, SYSTIMESTAMP AS REG_DT FROM dual ) src ON ( tgt.WK_ID = src.WK_ID AND tgt.LEFRM_ID = src.LEFRM_ID ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( WK_ID, LEFRM_ID, RGSR_ID, REG_DT ) VALUES ( src.WK_ID, src.LEFRM_ID, src.RGSR_ID, src.REG_DT )
mapper.delete: /* 업무 분류 클래스 전체 삭제(동기화 시 다시 만든다) - deleteOcrWcByWkId */ DELETE FROM ocuoc_ocrwc_l WHERE WK_ID = #{wkId}
